fields.statement: At eb79786e, internal/guide/text/import.md has a '## Record friction' section stating the rule (record every step you could not follow, or had to work around, as a question naming the step, so the import can improve; never work around one silently) and the question form `rhiza add question <handle> --field 'statement=Import step 3 (record built capabilities): <what, and how>'`. cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/import-friction-recorded.txtar checks that the form's example appears in `rhiza guide import` output, and runs the form in a fresh repo (fold-ok). Ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/guide/... (PASS: TestCaps now passes, so the attempt-1 finding about the 800-token cap is fixed) and go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(import-.*|guide)$' (PASS: import-friction-recorded, import-records-built, import-autonomous-decisions, import-retires-docs, import-unbuilt-as-drafts and guide). Reading the diff, the tightening keeps the other import steps' rules intact.
